bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model performance fluctuations when standard letter labels (e.g., A, B, C, D) are replaced with uniform, unordered labels like dashes or emojis across various benchmarks.
Executing answer-moving attacks by permuting the position of the ground-truth answer in multiple-choice questions and measuring the resulting variance in model accuracy.
Analyzing model reliance on the pattern or distribution of correct answers in few-shot exemplars, specifically using a synthetic diagnostic dataset (NonsenseQA) composed of random words.
Comparing model performance and robustness when required to output a single choice symbol versus generating a full-text answer that is then mapped to candidate options using semantic similarity.
